transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we're evaluating a 30% interest in LedgerSpring at a proposed purchase price of $8 million. Before I make any binding decision, I need to walk through this with each of you per our capital-allocation process. I'd like to start with a round-robin review: legal, treasury, and strategic partnerships. Could each of you share your assessment and any concerns so I can evaluate the final conditions? Let's start with whoever is ready.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a related-party issue I discovered this morning. In my related-party review, I found that LedgerSpring's chair also owns a small supplier of our current payment terminals. Under our related-party policy, this means two things must happen: first, we need an independent valuation before signing any investment commitment, and second, we need an audit-committee approval record on file before closing. I have not yet added this finding to the investment file, so I'm disclosing it now so we can factor it into the process before Elena makes any binding decision.
